{{RaceIcon|HighElf|Male}} {{RaceIcon|HighElf|Female}} [[High elf]] | capital = [[Vanguard]] | language = Common, Dwarven, Gnomish, Thalassian | affiliation = [[Alliance of Lordaeron]] | theater = [[Draenor]] | status = Unknown }} The '''Alliance Expedition''',Valley of Heroes monuments[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Dusts_of_Outland_(WC3_BloodElf) The Dusts of Outland (WC3 BloodElf)] also known as the '''Alliance expeditionary force'''''Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos'' game manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#The_Shaman,_Ner'zhul:_Origin_of_the_Lich_King Undead History]'', The Shaman, Ner'zhul: Origin of the Lich King and the '''Sons of Lothar''',{{questlong|Neutral|60R|Clutch of Thanlar (quest)|Clutch of Thanlar}} was a military venture to the orc homeworld of [[Draenor]] following the [[Second War]], with the goal of retrieving the [[Book of Medivh]] from [[Ner'zhul]] and stopping him from opening portals to other worlds. The expeditionary forces were led by: * Archmage [[Khadgar]] of [[Dalaran (kingdom)|Dalaran]], Supreme Commander. * [[Turalyon]], paladin of the [[Knights of the Silver Hand|Silver Hand]], High General. * Ranger Captain [[Alleria Windrunner]] of [[Quel'Thalas]], Lead Scout and Intelligence Agent. * [[Kurdran Wildhammer]] of [[Aerie Peak]], Commander of the Gryphon Rider Division. * [[Stromgarde (kingdom)|Stromgarde]] Militia Captain [[Danath Trollbane]], Force Commander and Tactical Advisor. While the expedition was ultimately successful in fighting the [[Shadowmoon clan]] and their allies in a string of military victories on Draenor and destroyed [[Fortress Shadowmoon]],[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Heart_of_Evil_(WC2_Human) The Heart of Evil (WC2 Human)] the [[Laughing Skull clan]] stole the Book of Medivh before Fortress Shadowmoon was destroyed and gave the Expedition the book along with soldiers in exchange for helping the traitor clan dominate on Draenor.[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Dance_of_the_Laughing_Skull_(WC2_Human) Dance of the Laughing Skull (WC2 Human)] However Ner'zhul had learned enough from the book to succeed with his plan to open numerous portals. Seeing the destruction of Draenor, the Alliance forces chose to close the [[Dark Portal]] in order to protect Azeroth from the influx of energy unleashed from the quickly dying world.[https://wowpedia.fandom/com/wiki/The_Bitter_Taste_of_Victory_(WC2_Human) The Bitter Taste of Victory (WC2 Human)] Their fate was unknown to those on Azeroth. They were last seen entering a portal to escape the destruction of Draenor. When Ner'zhul and his forces entered a different portal, they were immediately captured by the [[Burning Legion]],[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/The_Birth_of_the_Lich_King The Birth of the Lich King]''Warcraft III: Reign of Chaos'' manual, ''[https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Warcraft_III:_Reign_of_Chaos_Game_Manual#Lich Undead Hero Units]'', Lich though the fate of the Alliance Expedition is unknown. The heroes of the expedition are commemorated by statues in the [[Valley of Heroes]] in [[Stormwind City]]. ==References== {{reflist}}
